The autonomy level or the rules changed. Takes effect on the next action, not retroactively.

**Direction:** Chips → Harness  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`policy.updated.json`](/schema/policy.updated.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"policy.updated"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `harness_id` | yes | `string` | A harness identifier: `hrn_` followed by a ULID. |
| `policy` | yes | object | A harness's autonomy level and the rules that fill in the details. |
| `policy.autonomy` | yes | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | 0 observe, 1 ask first, 2 ask when it matters, 3 autonomous and report back. Presets that expand to rules. |
| `policy.rules` | yes | object[] | Evaluated in order; the workspace cap always wins. |
| `policy.rules[].match` | yes | `string` | A glob over action kinds, for example `payment.*`. |
| `policy.rules[].when` | no | object | Extra conditions on the action's flags, and for a command, how its parts start. |
| `policy.rules[].when.external` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.irreversible` | no | `boolean` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.money_usd_over` | no | `number` |  |
| `policy.rules[].when.risk` | no | enum[] | One of `external`, `external_communication`, `irreversible`, `destructive`, `financial`, `credential`, `privacy`, `legal`. |
| `policy.rules[].when.starts_with` | no | `string[]` | For an action that carries a command (ADR 0239): the words a part of it starts with. A command goes ahead on such rules only when every part starts with one that allows it. |
| `policy.rules[].decision` | yes | `"allow" \| "ask" \| "deny"` | What to do when the rule matches. |
| `policy.rules[].approvers` | no | `string[]` | Who may answer, when the decision is `ask`. |
| `policy.rules[].reason` | no | `string` | Shown to the harness, and recorded in the audit log. |
| `policy.rules[].off` | no | `boolean` | Turned off by a person (ADR 0195): kept in the list to turn back on, and skipped by the policy engine until then. |
| `policy.rules[].made_by` | no | `string` | Who made it by answering an ask with Always (ADR 0195). Filled in by Chips. |
| `policy.rules[].made_at` | no | `string` | When a person's answer made it (ADR 0195): Always, or This session. Filled in by Chips. A rule a person's answer made never allows an action that matters. |
| `workspace_max_autonomy` | yes | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3` | The workspace cap. It always wins. |
| `budget_usd` | no | `number` | The harness's spending ceiling, in US dollars. Absent leaves it as it was; the harness's spend is what `usage` has added up. |
| `changed_by` | yes | `string` | Who changed it, or `system` for an earned promotion. Filled in by Chips from the credential that sent it. |
| `reason` | no | `string` | Why it changed. |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "policy.updated",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX00000000000000007C",
  "ts": "2026-09-02T14:22:24.004Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "system",
    "id": "system"
  },
  "harness_id": "hrn_01K4ZQPX000000000000000004",
  "policy": {
    "autonomy": 2,
    "rules": [
      {
        "match": "email.send",
        "when": {
          "external": true
        },
        "decision": "ask",
        "approvers": ["owner"]
      }
    ]
  },
  "workspace_max_autonomy": 2,
  "budget_usd": 25,
  "changed_by": "system",
  "reason": "Six approvals in a row with no edits."
}
```
